asked.item: Status check returns 503 Service Unavailable intermittently
Whether to send the post again when the 503 happens
Right way to handle the 503 in an n8n flow

verdict.reason: No sentence covers a 503 from the Get Post Status call or says whether to resend after one; the nearby sentences cover a TikTok token refresh error and a missing TikTok post, which are different questions.
